summary: Deep learning optimization library for training and running very large models efficiently across many GPUs.

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: DeepSpeed is a deep learning optimization library for PyTorch that makes large-scale training and inference faster and cheaper. It includes C++/CUDA extensions, called ops, that are built just in time when needed.
sixtySeconds.problem: Training huge models runs into GPU memory and speed limits. DeepSpeed provides the system optimizations to train and serve them at scale.
whoFor: Teams using Hugging Face or Lightning at scale
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a widely used training optimizer that integrates with Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch Lightning and supports many hardware accelerators.
requirements: A CUDA or ROCm compiler such as nvcc or hipcc
A GPU; best tested on NVIDIA Pascal to Hopper and AMD MI100/MI200

overview: Install PyTorch first, then pip install deepspeed. Run ds_report to check your install and see which extensions your machine supports. Ops are JIT-compiled with ninja by default; advanced instructions cover pre-compiling them.
Contributed hardware support includes Intel Gaudi 2, Xeon and Data Center GPU Max, Huawei Ascend NPU and others.
For examples, see DeepSpeedExamples, Megatron-DeepSpeed and the Hugging Face Transformers and PyTorch Lightning integrations. DeepSpeed is Apache 2.0 licensed.
